[color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Description[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley Chaos Mod is a SMAPI mod that triggers random chaotic effects on a configurable timer, turning a peaceful farming sim into unpredictable mayhem. With 80+ effects spanning player buffs/debuffs, world manipulation, screen distortion, hostile NPCs, minigames, and more, no two playthroughs are ever the same. Supports Twitch integration for viewer voting on which effect hits next.[/color]


[heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (minimum version 4.0.0).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod and extract the [/color]

[code]StardewChaos[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder into your [/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][color=#D4D4D8] directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game — the mod is [b]disabled by default[/b]. Press [b]F7[/b] in-game to open the configuration menu and enable it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8](Optional) Configure Twitch integration, difficulty pools, and individual effect toggles through the F7 menu.[/color]

On first launch, the mod creates a config.json in the mod folder (Mods/StardewChaos/). [/*]
[/list][list]
[*]TwitchOAuth=oauth:your-token-here  [/*]
[*]TwitchUsername=your-twitch-username[/*]
[*]TwitchChannel=your-channel-name
.[/*]
[/list][list]
One method for getting your OAuth token, is to use https://twitchtokengenerator.com/ . Select Custom Scope Token. Make sure Chat : Read is toggled. Then select Generate Token. It will have you log in via Twitch. Save all the information on the next screen. Your access token is what you will include in the text file after:  TwitchOAuth= After launching the game again, enable the mod in the F7 menu, then toggle Twitch Voting to On.[/list]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Main features[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]80+ random chaos effects[/b] across four difficulty tiers: Basic, Complex, and Weird[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Timed effect system[/b] — effects fire on a configurable interval with full timer management[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Twitch voting[/b] — viewers vote on the next effect via chat[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Daily effects[/b] — unique day-long modifiers[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]F7 configuration menu[/b] — enable/disable the mod, toggle difficulties, toggle individual effects, and manage other seetings[/color]
[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0.0 or later[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) A Twitch channel for viewer voting integration[/color]
[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Shout outs[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Zolika1351[/b] — creator of the [url=https://zolika1351.pages.dev/chaos/gtasa]GTA chaos mods[/url], [url=https://zolika1351.pages.dev/chaos/rdr2]RDR2 chaos mod[/url], and chaos mods for numerous other games. The entire concept of a timer-based random effect system with Twitch voting, difficulty pools, combo mechanics, and minigame penalties was directly inspired by their work. This mod is a love letter to that formula, transplanted into Stardew Valley.[/color][/*]
